item.title: Fine Jewellery Manufacturing named among first Positive Luxury Good Suppliers
item.description: Retail Jeweller Fine Jewellery Manufacturing named among first Positive Luxury Good Suppliers Fine Jewellery Manufacturing Ltd has been recognised as one of the first businesses successfully vetted under Positive Luxury’s Good Supplier Programme, an initiative designed to help luxury brands identify trusted partners that meet robust ESG standards. item.title: Martin Rapaport announces launch of Green Source diamonds initiative
item.description: Retail Jeweller Martin Rapaport announces launch of Green Source diamonds initiative Industry figure Martin Rapaport has announced the launch of Green Source Corporation, alongside a new Green Source hallmark designed to identify what the organisation describes as “diamonds that make the world a better place”. item.description: Retail Jeweller Boucheron high jewellery brooch acquired by the V&A A high jewellery creation by Boucheron has been acquired by the Victoria and Albert Museum for display in its jewellery galleries. Boucheron high jewellery brooch acquired by the V&A Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Natural Diamond Council 2025 report shows natural diamond sales growth
item.description: Retail Jeweller Natural Diamond Council 2025 report shows natural diamond sales growth The Natural Diamond Council has released its latest report, Natural Diamond Trends: A 2025 Overview, revealing continued consumer appetite for natural diamonds and steady growth across US speciality retail. Natural Diamond Council 2025 report shows natural diamond sales growth Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Citizen unveils limited edition “Shades of Red” models
item.description: Retail Jeweller Citizen unveils limited edition “Shades of Red” models Watch brand Citizen has launched two new limited edition ATTESA timepieces inspired by the striking red moon seen during a total lunar eclipse, ahead of the celestial event set to be visible across Japan on 3 March 2026 at 8.04pm. Citizen unveils limited edition “Shades of Red” models Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller Final stands remaining at Retail Jeweller Festival 2026 There are just a handful of stands left ahead of the forthcoming Retail Jeweller Festival, which returns on 16 and 17 March for its sixth edition. item.title: UK footfall decline slows in January as retail parks return to growth
item.description: Retail Jeweller UK footfall decline slows in January as retail parks return to growth UK retail footfall showed signs of stabilising in January 2026, with overall visits down just 0.6% year on year, a significant improvement on December’s 2.9% decline, according to the latest BRC Sensormatic Footfall Monitor covering 4 to 31 January. UK footfall decline slows in January as retail parks return to growth Ruth Faulkner

item.title: IAC and World Gold Council to host webinar exploring definition of responsibly sourced gold
item.description: Retail Jeweller IAC and World Gold Council to host webinar exploring definition of responsibly sourced gold Initiatives in Arts and Culture (IAC), in collaboration with the World Gold Council, will host an upcoming webinar examining what “responsibly sourced gold” means across the global gold industry.
